Comprehension:Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.One of the most serious worldwide concerns of the twenty-first century is terrorism, which is defined as the illegal use of force and intimidation, particularly against civilians. In contrast to traditional warfare, terrorism uses fear and uncertainty to destabilise nations and sway political outcomes. To enlist new members and defend their acts, terrorist organisations frequently take use of political, religious, or ideological issues. Terrorism has changed throughout time, moving from small-scale acts to intricate global operations that are frequently coordinated online.Cyberterrorism has become more well-known in recent years, the internet is utilised for sensitive data theft and disruption in addition to recruiting and propaganda. In response, governments everywhere have implemented counterterrorism measures, ranging from military interventions and policy changes to monitoring systems and intelligence-sharing partnerships. But fighting terrorism involves more than just using force. It is equally important to address underlying issues like political oppression, social estrangement, and poverty.Finding a balance between civil freedom and national security is the difficult part. Racial profiling and overzealous surveillance can backfire, alienating communities and bolstering radical narratives. As a result, counterterrorism tactics need to be sophisticated, inclusive, and internationally coordinated. Societies may only then hope to reduce the threat while maintaining the values they are trying to safeguard.Another important factor in the fight against terrorism is education. Early exposure to critical thinking, tolerance, and intercultural understanding can help protect people against radical views. It is possible to lessen the appeal of radical groups and promote more resilient, cohesive communities by empowering young people via education and providing chances for positive civic engagement.In the context of the passage, what does 'alienating' mean?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Cutting off or isolating) है।
